title: Machine Learning Prediction of Absence of Formal Healthcare Seeking for Acutely Ill Children in Sub-Saharan Africa: A 38-Country IECV Study
description: Complete, reproducible codebase and documentation package for predicting the absence of formal healthcare seeking for acutely ill children under 5 across 38 sub-Saharan African countries using Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS) microdata. Includes data extraction scanners, harmonization protocols, 5 machine learning models (ElasticNet, Random Forest, HistGradientBoosting, XGBoost, LightGBM), 5-fold cross-validation, 38-country leave-one-country-out internal-external cross-validation (IECV), SHAP explainability, and eight prespecified sensitivity analyses.

creators.name: Pediatric ML Research Consortium
